column2: \textbf{Description of Changes}
First prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Migration to AUTOSAR 20.11 (RTA-CAR 12.0).
Second prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Modification of the interface IF_BSPMP_RmtProgmActvAuth and removed DIAG_BSPMP_RmtProgmActvAuth_Reference parameter.
Third prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Document version updated.
Second prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Document version updated.
Third prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Adding BatteryVoltage_DisableNVMWrite port interface

Fourth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Add new NvM blocks reference parameters for MEC and OTA PSF values to address the respective NV data directly without the need of per-instance-memory. Update consequently the PIM diction with RAM block mirror everywhere in the document.

Fifth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Add new configuration parameter DiagInitFuncPeriodicity for the periodicity of the init runnable. Change the init runnable enabling parameter name to DiagGenerateInitRunnable. \newline \\Updated the names of the port interfaces DIAG_SOH_GetMEC, SSC_DIAG_GetMEC to the new DIAG_GetMEC port interface and add a new PP_DIAG_SSFM_GetMEC port.
Sixth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Added section \ref{sec:controldtc} ControlDTCSetting, updated section \ref{section:Interface}.\\ Updated document's reference.
Seventh prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Documents version updated.
Eighth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Updated section \ref{section:Interface} and \ref{sec:otaflag}.
Ninth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Updated section \ref{sec:Artifacts}.

Tenth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Updated section \ref{section:Interface} DIAG is not accountable for managing SBAT DID 0xF0F4 and 0xE0B5, as these will be handled by SSC.
Twelfth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Updated section \ref{subsection:general} with DCM references.

Thirteenth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Updated section \ref{subsection:general} with the new periodicity configurations and updated DiagGeneral images with the latest configurations.

Fourteenth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Added new parameters DIAG_ServiceBased_OTA_DataTypeMappingSet and DIAG_ServiceBased_OTA_Ref to section \ref{subsection:general}. Added new subsection \ref{sec:servicebasedota} for service-based OTA configuration with detailed parameter documentation and configuration dependencies.
Fifteenth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Version updated.
Sixteenth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Version updated.
Seventeen prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Added SUM_DIAG_DcmGetRxPermission protocol pre-emption callout guidance (protocol, tester source address, power mode).
Eighteen prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Update section \ref{sec:controldtc} replacing DcmControlDTCSetting with SUM_ControlDTCSetting interface.
Nineteen prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Update section \ref{subsection:general} and \ref{section:Interface} to support DID 0xE0CC.
Twentieth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Added section \ref{sec:inputvalidation} to enable input validation in the arxml bamf.
Twenty-first prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Document version updated.
Twenty-second prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Document version updated.
Twenty-third prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Document version updated.
Twenty-fourth prototype release of RTA-SUM DIAG 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\Document version updated.
